text: {"final": {"verdict": "reject", "reason": "rerouted_sites compares the full (route, vehicle) tuples from best_route and passable_route, so a vehicle-only change is counted as a reroute, contradicting the ticket ('the vehicle alone changing does not count') and the plan step's own statement. Concrete case in data/network.json: SITE-NVL-B — best_route picks RT-02 (roads R-01 status A, R-03 status R) with 'truck'; passable_route finds RT-02 usable by van (R-03 is restricted, vans allowed) and returns (RT-02, 'van'). Same route, different vehicle, yet the tuples differ so SITE-NVL-B is wrongly added. Same for SITE-HGL-B: RT-09's only road R-13 is restricted, so passable_route returns (RT-09, 'van') vs best_route's (RT-09, 'truck'). The comparison must be on the route only, e.g. best_route(warehouse, site, network)[0] != passable_route(warehouse, site, network)[0] (or compare route ids), with a None check. The rest of the edit is fine: passable_route's truck-then-van logic matches can_pass in logistics/access.py, ordering (km, id) matches best_route, best_route and the other functions are unchanged, and the import of can_pass is correct."}}
reasoning:
Check the proposed edit against the code.

passable_route: uses can_pass(road, "truck", network) — can_pass signature is (road_id, vehicle, network=None). Good. Logic: truck if all truck-passable, else van if all van-passable, else skip. Matches ticket. min by (km, id) matches best_route ordering. Good.

rerouted_sites: iterates network["routes"], compares best_route vs passable_route. best_route returns (route, vehicle); passable_route returns (route, vehicle). If route differs, tuples differ. If route same but vehicle differs (truck vs van), tuples differ too — but ticket says vehicle-only change does not count. Wait: if the route is the same but vehicle changes... can that happen? passable_route picks the same route as best_route but with van when truck can't use it. E.g., RT-02: roads R-01 (A), R-03 (R). Truck can't pass R-03, van can. So passable_route returns (RT-02, "van") while best_route returns (RT-02, "truck"). Tuples differ → site added, but ticket says vehicle-only change does not count. That's a bug!

Check: SITE-NVL-B routes: RT-02 (22km, R-01 A, R-03 R) and RT-03 (31km, R-04 A, R-05 A). best_route picks RT-02 with truck. passable_route: RT-02 truck fails (R-03 restricted), van passes both → (RT-02, "van"). Same route, different vehicle. rerouted_sites would include SITE-NVL-B incorrectly.

The plan step even says "a vehicle-only change does not count, per the ticket" but the implementation compares full tuples, which counts vehicle-only changes. So reject.

Correct comparison: compare best_route(...)[0] != passable_route(...)[0] (route ids), or compare route dicts.

Also check other sites: SITE-CPL-B: RT-05 has R-08 (X) — unusable; RT-06 has R-09 (R) — van only → (RT-06, "van") vs best (RT-05, "truck") — route differs, correctly counted. SITE-HGL-A: RT-07 has R-12 (X) unusable; RT-08 all A → (RT-08, "truck") vs best (RT-07, "truck") — differs, counted. SITE-HGL-B: RT-09 R-13 (R) — van only → (RT-09, "van") vs best (RT-09, "truck") — same route, vehicle only → should NOT count, but implementation counts it. SITE-NVL-A: RT-01 all A → same. SITE-CPL-A: RT-06... RT-04 all A → same.

So the bug affects SITE-NVL-B and SITE-HGL-B. Reject.
